scope: AI-assisted source comparison of FCC order, AAS response and attributed trade reporting. No human-review, interview, technical replication or deployed impact measurement is claimed.
unknowns: Actual deployment, operational compute capacity and cost competitiveness were not independently established.
AAS concerns are attributed predictions; future impacts have not been measured here.
Subsequent modifications, superseding rules and compliance reports may change the conditions.

claims.claim: The Nov 25 order authorizes a conditional million-satellite Starmind constellation, 500–1002km.
claims.unknowns: Authorization is not evidence of completed deployment.

claims.claim: RF grant covers backup and emergency TT&C on non-interference, unprotected Ka-band terms; optical links are primary.
claims.unknowns: Not a technical demonstration of optical network performance.

claims.claim: Alternative disposal waiver is deferred and requires modification before satellites using non-reentry disposal can deploy and operate.
claims.unknowns: Not a finding that the entire constellation is prohibited or unsafe.

claims.claim: Milestones are one satellite in 2033, 10% in 2035, 50% in 2038, completion in 2040; license term starts with certified compliant first operations.
claims.unknowns: Regulatory deadlines are not commercial availability forecasts.

claims.claim: FCC declines additional optical astronomy conditions and excludes non-RF viability issues from controlling scope.
claims.unknowns: Regulatory judgment does not resolve future physical impacts.

claims.claim: AAS objects on brightness, radio, heat, pollution and collision grounds.
claims.unknowns: Advocacy statement, not measurement of an operational Starmind constellation.

claims.claim: Thermal and economic viability remain unproven by this approval.
claims.unknowns: No independent hardware test, cost model or future impact study performed.

claims.claim: Semiannual reporting conditions enumerate conjunctions, removals, reentries, deployments and backup Ka use.
claims.unknowns: Subject to superseding reporting rules, not a guarantee of reporting quality.

claims.claim: A license clears a gate, not the sky; readers should track separate evidence for each claimed achievement.
claims.unknowns: Editorial conclusion derived from the stated scope and unresolved conditions.

sister_body_comparison.method: PS-only task; no sister article created. Existing PS/recovery corpus checked for underlying-event duplicates.
